about: Size limits for the always-loaded surface this repo SHIPS (issues #501, #503, for #435). These limit SIZE, not compliance. Enforced by test/surface-limit.test.js via scripts/surface-count.js; change a limit only with --write-limits, in the same diff as the growth. Per-machine files (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md) are limited in the project's store, never here.
